//: Survivor marks: flat floor markings. Walk-over, transparent, items can lie on them. Deconstruct to scrub off. Furniture (not vanilla graffiti) so EOCs and later NPC wayfinding can find them by id.
name: chalk mark: LOOTED
description: A big X scrawled on the floor, and under it the word LOOTED.  Someone has already been through here and taken what was worth taking.

name: chalk mark: CAMP
description: A triangle like a tent, scrawled on the floor: CAMP.  People live near here, or did.

name: chalk mark: DANGER
description: A jagged exclamation mark and the word DANGER, gone over twice so it would not be missed.  Whoever wrote this did not want you going any further.

name: chalk mark: WATER, north
description: An arrow and the word WATER, pointing north.

name: chalk mark: WATER, east
description: An arrow and the word WATER, pointing east.

name: chalk mark: WATER, south
description: An arrow and the word WATER, pointing south.

name: chalk mark: WATER, west
description: An arrow and the word WATER, pointing west.
